name: tun0 VPN
author: Roger Tobler
description: OpenVPN profiles from any provider with their own nftables kill switch, a reconnect watchdog, trusted Wi-Fi networks and a terminal-free import - one shield in the bar.

barWidget.description: Connect, switch country, watch throughput and where you come out, trust the Wi-Fi you are on, arm the kill switch.

schema.label: Status interval (seconds)
schema.description: While idle. With the panel open, or while a connect is negotiating, it polls every second on its own.

schema.label: Profile name in the bar
schema.description: Show the connected profile next to the shield (proton-ch). Off = icon only.

schema.label: Accent colour while connected
schema.description: Paint the shield in the theme's accent colour while the tunnel is up. Red is reserved for a tunnel that is down.

schema.label: Throughput in the bar
schema.description: Append the current download rate to the bar label while connected.
